title: Contemper
summary: CONTEMPER, verb transitive [Latin , to mix or temper. See Temper.] To moderate; to reduce to a lower degree by mixture with opposite or different qualities; to temper. The leaves qualify and contemper

inlines.v: CONTEMPER, verb transitive [Latin , to mix or temper. See Temper.] To moderate; to reduce to a lower degree by mixture with opposite or different qualities; to temper. The leaves qualify and contemper the heat.
